analysis:
This PR is CI, build tooling, tests and docs only. It touches no provider runtime, coordinator wire contract, key custody, App Attest or attestation, or prefix-cache storage code (T-041, TB-011, TB-012). I found no concrete regression against the provider threat model.

Security-relevant behavior examined:
- Cache saves: SAVE_CACHES limits saves to pushes on master/dev, and the composite action's save-caches input gates every cache/save step (action.yml:7-9, 101-148). The old rule let a pull request save when nothing matched. Pull requests now only restore, which narrows cache-poisoning surface.
- .git cache: it is restored, checked with git fsck --connectivity-only, and saved at most once a day. Checkouts use persist-credentials: false, so the job token is not stored in the cached .git/config. Workflow permissions stay at contents: read, and actions stay pinned by SHA.
- install-release-cmake.sh (head lines 10-31): it now uses a runner tool-cache CMake when a universal.complete marker exists and the binary reports version 3.31.12. That copy gets no SHA-256 check. The download path still verifies the pinned hash. Docs say release, signing and publication jobs keep literal Blacksmith labels, and the image provisioning is said to verify the archive. The scripts and workflows that would confirm this are not fully supplied. I treat it as an unverified trust assumption, not a finding.
- docs-impact.yml: sparse, blobless checkout of the PR head. This is pre-existing in kind.
- mimo_audio: a new routing component. A routing gap would only skip an audio test (a coverage question, not a vulnerability), and master pushes run all components.

Open questions for deeper review:
(1) A saved .git is trusted by later runs, since fsck checks connectivity only. Integrity rests on push-only, ref-scoped saves. Confirm that no PR-writable path or untrusted runner class (for example Darkbloom sandbox runners sharing the git-v1-Linux key) can write the master/dev scope.
(2) The full head of ci.yml (the shifted cluster, summary and provider-test-gate jobs, and the mimo_audio steps) was not visible. Confirm the gate still fails closed.
(3) Confirm the tool-cache immutability and routing-plane contracts. The replay is incomplete (54 units omitted), so coverage is limited.
